name: remove.free
description: Ultra-fast, 100% private on-device background remover for humans and autonomous AI agents.
privacy: 100% Client-Side Neural Execution. Zero server uploads. Zero data retention.

url_automation.description: Direct in-browser execution with WebGPU hardware acceleration, WASM fallback. No server-side component: the image is fetched by the browser itself.

parameters.src: Public URL of image to process (auto-triggers cutout pipeline). Fetched cross-origin by the browser, so the host MUST send permissive CORS headers (Access-Control-Allow-Origin). Hosts without CORS cannot be read; use the file picker or clipboard paste for those.
parameters.model: Optional model id. One of: birefnet-lite, rmbg-1.4. Defaults to birefnet-lite.

dom_contract.status: #status (reads 'WxH · Ns' upon completion, or starts with 'failed')

constraints.reason: There is no server-side proxy. Nothing in this app is metered or rate-limited.
alternatives: Use an image host that sends Access-Control-Allow-Origin (most image CDNs do).
Paste an image from the clipboard (Cmd/Ctrl+V).
Select a local file via the file picker.

models.label: BiRefNet Lite
models.attribution: BiRefNet by Peng Zheng et al., ONNX conversion by onnx-community. MIT licensed.
models.notes: Best edge quality on hair and fur. No int8 export exists upstream, so CPU mode is a large download and slow.

models.label: RMBG 1.4
models.attribution: RMBG v1.4 by BRIA AI, used under CC BY-NC 4.0. Non-commercial use only.
models.notes: Smallest and fastest on both backends. Non-commercial use only.

runtime.backend_selection: WebGPU when navigator.gpu is present, otherwise WASM. Every model runs on both.
runtime.weights_hosting: Fetched by the browser directly from object storage. Weights never transit an application server.
runtime.model_cache: Cached in the browser after first load; works offline thereafter.
runtime.server_side_code: None. Fully static; every request is a static asset.

samples.description: Bundled sample images, same-origin static assets.
